title: Packet retention of a terminal review attempt is retried on every poll when it keeps failing
outcome: When the parent's compact termal_get_session_result packet publishes a completed or failed reviewer's unconfirmed terminal attempt (the w-b18b11972c44 path) and that retention keeps failing (for example a capture error), repeated packet reads from waits or UI polling don't repeat a full retention attempt every time. The failure stays reported in retainedReviewAttemptsError, with a bounded retry policy.
acceptance: Repeated parent packet reads of a terminal reviewer whose retention fails persistently do not run a full retention or capture on every read; the retry policy is bounded and documented, and retainedReviewAttemptsError still reports the failure each time.
A behavioural test shows the bounded retry with deterministic counts, not timing.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
